text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've got a whodunit on our hands!
Someone
stole Mejiro McQueen's
pudding during lunch
today!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
But never fear, Detective Golshi's on the
case!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
While I'm not exactly reassured by your
presence,
I appreciate your assistance.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
First things first... The way things go,
the one who
discovered the crime's usually
the most sus,
sooo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Why are you looking at me like that?!
Besides,
the pudding is still missing, so
no one has
"discovered" it yet!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. This is all part of the
detective
process. Anyway, do you have
an alibi?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Umm... No one was watching me,
exactly, but I
was simply eating my lunch
as I normally do...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And the pudding was accounted for
when you sat
down?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I even opened the lid slightly to
indicate it
was mine.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The lid?! Was it open halfway, by any
chance?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, but how would you know that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Dun, dun, dun! I've cracked the case!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The only fiend capable of a heist like
this...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Is master thief Golshi the Third! I stake
my name
on it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a flash, Gold Ship takes off faster
than I've
ever seen her run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Stop right there, Gold Ship! Ugh, when
did you
get so fast?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Speed is an indispensable part of a
master thief's
arsenal! It's how she always
makes her escape!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Argh! I'll get you next time, mark my
words!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! You'll never catch me,
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship's form got remarkably sharp
after that,
but very few know the real
reason why...
